ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: LANCE uses the camera to record your clips.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: LANCE records the sound of your clips.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: LANCE listens for you to say "save" or "record" so you can save a clip without touching your phone.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: LANCE saves the clips you export to your photo library.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: LANCE uses your local network to talk to the other phone you use as a remote.
